title: the frame, the floor and M12 are already defined in this repo; the reconstruction runs end to end

the_four_charges.definition: INV[8], INV[14], INV[16], INV[22] = the 2T-invariant vectors, one in each of the principal-sl(2) blocks V8, V14, V16, V22 of e6
the_four_charges.why_those_four_blocks: 2T (binary tetrahedral, 24 unit quaternions) has an invariant in Sym^n exactly for n in {8,14,16,22} among the six exponent blocks; they are Klein's forms PhiPsi, t.PhiPsi, (PhiPsi)^2, t.(PhiPsi)^2
the_four_charges.representation_named: adjoint sector (elements of e6), NOT 27 vectors

the_frame.definition: the ordered tuple (g8, g14, g16, g22) with its Killing Gram K(x,y) = tr(ad x . ad y): diagonal, signature (2,2); {g8,g16} noncompact (+), {g14,g22} compact (-)

the_core.definition: z(g8) = z(g16) = z(g8,g16), dim 30 (type so(8)+u(1)^2, banked lineage)

the_floor.definition: z_e6(g8,g14,g16,g22) = ker(ad g14 | core), dim 12 = A2 + u(1)^4 = su(3)_colour + the four charges

kappa_and_the_compact_walls.definition: compact pencil h(s) = g14 + s.g22 on the 18-dim quotient core/floor; nu(s) = det = c.kappa(s)^6; kappa = 2771822592000 s^3 + 3033676800 s^2 - 56402640 s - 6859, irreducible, kappa(0) = -19^3, disc squarefree kernel {7,11}; W_j = ker(ad g14 + s_j ad g22), dim 30 each, triple span 66

M12.definition: the Killing-perp of span(W1,W2,W3); dim 12 = 78 - 66; canonical
advertised_properties: ker((ad g8 + rho_i ad g16)|M12) = 4 at each generation wall

the_generation_walls.definition: roots of N(t) = det(ad(g8 + t.g16) | e6/core), degree 48, N = c.(cubic)^16; equal to mu's roots; z(x_i) = so(10)+u(1), dim 46
the_generation_walls.normalization_hazard: mu_solo(rho) = 13^3 . CUBIC_banked(rho/13); mixing lanes gives a structurally wrong all-18 pairing table, not a noisy one

W_frame.definition: the Klein four sign group {identity, flip(g14,g22), flip(g8,g16), flip-all} on the frame coordinates; realized in Aut(e6) as P(C8), C8 = <phi+, sigma_c, sigma_-1>, kernel {1, sigma_-1}
